Zero-Egress Privacy Policy

Effective Date: October 15, 2026 • Canonical Domain: https://zothos.nullai.tech • Entity: Neal Frazier Tech (@1nc0gn30) • NullAI Platform

1. Zero Telemetry & 100% Client-Side Computation

Both ZothOS Linux v3.3.0 & ZothOS-Lite v1.0 and https://zothos.nullai.tech operate under a strict Zero-Telemetry Invariant. All terminal simulations, MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 tool calls, Argon2id key derivations, and custom ISO live-build recipes execute 100% locally in your browser. License activation states are stored exclusively in your browser's local storage (`localStorage`).

2. Payment Processing

Payments are processed directly via decentralized Solana Web3 rails (DePay). We never store private wallet keys or sensitive payment credentials.
